question:
Select the correct active form.

"He is known to me."
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the given passive voice sentence: "He is known to me."
 
• To convert to active voice: Identify the subject "he" and the object "me."
 
• The correct active voice sentence is: "I know him."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I know him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"I knew him." – Incorrect because it uses past tense instead of present.
 
• **Option 3: **"I had known him." – Incorrect because it uses past perfect tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"I know about him." – Incorrect because it adds "about" which changes the meaning of the sentence.
